Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a), which shows a massive right-sided opacity causing leftward mediastinal shift, with the post-operative image (Figure 1c), the mass has been removed and the right lung has re-expanded but remains partially opaque/atlectatic. The heart and trachea remain shifted to the left, likely due to residual volume loss or fibrosis, rather than returning to the midline.
